title: channel_plan.py: select_channel returns out-of-bounds index for plans with < 3 channels
description: Lines 87-88 and 311-312: For a 2-channel plan, n = max(2-1, 2) = 2, so '1 + (h % 2)' can return 2, which exceeds valid indices [0,1]. Similarly for 1-channel plans. Would cause IndexError when passed to frequency(). Currently mitigated by all defined plans having >= 8 channels, but is a latent bug for custom plans.
